text_block_list.text: Just as morning classes are about to<n>start...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait! Wait for meee! Don't close the<n>gate!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Did I make it? Whew! Imade it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not okay! Because both of<n>my...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I have two alarm clocks that I set<n>every night, and
somehow, both of<n>their batteries died at the same
time!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They say to always have a spare, but<n>I think my
spare needs a spare! And<n>I'll need to verify all
three are<n>working before going to sleep every―

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Right, thanks! Urk! Maybe I can still<n>make it in time!

Her usual grace and wisdom<n>seemingly gone, Biwa
Hayahide runs<n>toward the school building with her
wild locks trailing behind her like a<n>comet tail.
